name: The bench beside the river
subtitle: A small story about a familiar place.
body:
On the first warm morning, Mira took the long way to the market. The river was quiet, and someone had left a small pot of yellow flowers on the old bench.

She sat for a moment. Across the water, a bicycle bell rang twice. A man with a paper bag stopped to look at the flowers, then smiled as if he had remembered something.

By noon, three people had added a note beneath the pot. Mira brought a pencil the next day. Some places become a meeting place before anyone decides to call them one.
